title: Prioritised backlog of small batches
statement: Retrospect keeps a ranked backlog of small, single-PR improvements to the delivery process.

criteria.then: the one with more expected minutes saved times confidence, per hour of effort and risk, ranks higher

criteria.given: an opportunity over 200 changed lines, or missing a hypothesis or target metric
criteria.then: it is left out of the ranking with a reason

criteria.given: a technique with a track record of successes and failures
criteria.then: confidence is the Beta(1,1) posterior mean, 0.5 with no history

criteria.given: a backlog with queued, in-progress and finished items
criteria.then: only queued items are ranked, and ties are broken by id

criteria.given: invalid inputs (non-positive effort, confidence outside 0-1, negative risk or saving)
criteria.then: scoring throws instead of producing a misleading number
